[[File:Great Serpent Ring.gif|thumb|right|150px|The Aes Sedai Great Serpent Ring]]
The '''great serpent''' is an ancient {{Wiki|ouroboros}} symbol of the eternal and cyclic nature of time. Its usage predates [[Wheel of Time|the wheel]].

[[Aes Sedai]] wear a [[Great Serpent ring|gold ring]] with this symbol on the finger and hand of their choice, if they choose to wear it at all, in addition to their shawl to indicate their position.

[[Accepted]] wear this ring on their third finger of their left hand.

==Background==
The great serpent is used as end-of-chapter icons as well as in the maps of the books.
